title: University Scholarship Application

instructions.name: Complete scholarship application
instructions.description: Provide personal, academic, residency, and household financial information.

instructions.name: Submit identity proof
instructions.description: Upload a government-issued identity document matching the applicant name.

instructions.name: Submit academic records
instructions.description: Upload the most recent academic transcript and enrollment information.

instructions.name: Submit bank details
instructions.description: Provide an active bank account for scholarship disbursement.

submission_window: Applications are accepted from August 1 through September 30, 2026.
